title: Real interactive PowerShell, Python and Node terminals
summary: Replace the web script form with full-screen real persistent PTY terminals, keyboard input and session controls.

changes.detail: Installed node-pty and xterm.js with fit addon. Real persistent interpreters support input, state, directory changes, resizing, Ctrl+C and restart.
Web lab uses full-screen terminal tabs instead of prefilled script forms. Owner-authenticated local-only sessions have bounded output, idle expiry and close cleanup; native script lab remains.

validation.name: Checks
validation.detail: Pending PTY runtime tests, frontend checks and HTTP/asset verification. No deployment.
